name: Kytheon Iora
description: A legendary hero who with his irregulars fought the cyclops at Akros, whose tactics the narrator echoes.

timeline.summary: As an orphan on the streets the narrator resolves to become a legend greater than Kytheon Iora.
timeline.quote: I would be greater than Kytheon.

relations.note: Kytheon led irregulars who fought the cyclops at Akros.
relations.quote: Everyone knows the stories of Kytheon Iora and his irregulars
